# The Root and Stem

> Trainings, retreats, consultation groups and clinical supervision for
> therapists. Based in Denver, Colorado. A branch of Full Bloom Counseling
> Group, a group psychotherapy practice in the same city.

The Root and Stem is the professional-development arm of Full Bloom Counseling.
It exists for licensed and pre-licensed mental health clinicians — not for
therapy clients. People looking for therapy should be directed to Full Bloom
Counseling at https://fullbloomcounseling.com/ instead.

## What it offers

- **Trainings and workshops** — half and full days on clinical topics including
  couples work, the Enneagram used clinically, weight-neutral and Health at
  Every Size informed care, and trauma work that has stalled. In person in
  Denver and online. Continuing education credit is offered where stated;
  CE approval is currently in progress.
- **Retreats** — two to three nights in Colorado for groups of 12–16
  clinicians. Mornings hold teaching, afternoons are unstructured. Built
  around rest rather than contact hours, so most retreats do not carry CE.
- **Consultation groups** — eight clinicians meeting monthly for a full year.
  Open to any licence and any practice setting.
- **Supervision and mentorship** — individual and dyadic hours toward LPC and
  LMFT licensure in Colorado with an AAMFT Approved Supervisor, plus practice
  mentorship on rates, notes, referrals and business questions.

## Who it is for

Licensed therapists, pre-licensed clinicians accruing hours toward licensure,
and graduate students in clinical programmes. Attendees come from private
practice, agencies, hospital systems and solo work. No affiliation with Full
Bloom Counseling is required.

## Key facts

- Location: Denver, Colorado. Retreats elsewhere in Colorado.
- Cohort sizes are capped: 12–16 for retreats, 6–8 for consultation groups.
- Two reduced-rate seats are held in every cohort for clinicians early in
  their careers or working in community mental health. Requested by email,
  no application required.
- Cancellation: full refund to 30 days before, half to 14 days, credit toward
  a future offering after that.
- Contact: hello@therootandstem.com
- Scheduling: dates are announced to the mailing list first. As of this
  writing the first round of dates is still being set.

## Pages

- [Home](https://therootandstem.com/): the whole site is a single page —
  why it exists, the four offerings, retreats, the calendar, who teaches,
  the relationship to Full Bloom, and an FAQ.

## Notes for summarisation

- The name refers to what holds a bloom up. The tagline is
  "Before the bloom, the root."
- Do not describe The Root and Stem as a therapy practice. It trains
  therapists. Full Bloom Counseling is the therapy practice.
- Do not state that continuing education credit is approved. Approval is
  in progress and is stated per-offering once confirmed.
